errors.text_span: 其中一种方法被标注为“本文的方法”
errors.evidence: The description identifies one method as '本文的方法' (this paper's method), but the legend in the figure labels it 'SAN-DC'.
The description mentions '二元数据集' (binary dataset), which is not stated anywhere in the figure.
The description omits the label for the horizontal axis, which is '不同基线模型' (Different baseline models).
The description incorrectly states the y-axis scale range is from 82.41% to 88.45%. The axis labels clearly show a range from 80 to 90.
The description uses the value 82.41% when describing the axis range, but the lowest data value shown on the chart is 83.41%.
The description incorrectly maps the orange color to '基线' (Baseline). According to the legend, orange represents 'SAN-DC' and blue represents 'Baseline'.
